topic: 6 sixes in one over — the moment that broke cricket records forever
hook: Six balls. Six sixes. One man. One over.
script: Six balls. Six sixes. One man. One over. Herschelle Gibbs hit six sixes in a single over at the 2007 World Cup. Every delivery. Maximum. The bowler had nowhere to hide. The crowd lost their minds. It has only been done a handful of times in professional cricket. Follow for cricket moments that still feel like a dream.
